description: Aave V4 liquidations from the subgraph (Base by default): liquidator, borrower, spoke, collateral/debt reserves, debt restored, collateral seized, shares moved and premium deltas, newest first, plus a per-liquidator count. Filter by liquidator or user. Not exposed by the official Aave V4 API.

liquidator.description: Only liquidations by this liquidator address

network.description: V4 deployment: 'base' (default, Coinbase tokenized-stocks hub) or 'ethereum' (Core/Plus/Prime)

sinceHours.description: Look back N hours (default: all time)

user.description: Only liquidations of this borrower address

name: get_v4_recent_liquidations
